requirement: The Studio chair (distinct from the NDCA Chairman and the WSDC Chief Judge) may lock ballots, mark and void no-shows, record judge absence, and co-sign exclusion, withdrawal and correction; the chair may not calculate, approve, publish, reopen ballots, initiate an exclusion or change the running order.
enforcement_point: Database role function _compe2_round_role plus per-function role gates; running-order functions use can_manage_event_competition, which has no chair branch.

tests.name: the chair is refused: initiate exclusion/reversal, recover correction, reopen, approve, complete, open correction

interpretation_notes: Inspected every reachable gate. The chair is a database role, never an NDCA Chairman or WSDC Chief Judge (body official designations: OD-06, PR 834; scheduling authority: OD-26, PR 854). A person who is also a manager keeps manager powers through the manager role, not the chair designation. Gap: chair negative SQL tests exist in A5/E2/U66/A6/A7/NS1 but none asserts a chair is refused calculate, approve, publish, complete, cancel or the running-order writers; the static pins cover them and a SQL negative matrix is a PENDING follow-up. service_role may call the 10D running-order writers (trusted server only). DanceFlow Studio/Custom policy, never a governing-body requirement. Verified here by SQL inspection and static pins only; the SQL suites named were NOT executed by this session (PENDING an isolated Postgres under the heavy-lock queue). Independent review: R12-F9 (chair who is also a manager keeps manager power).
decision_refs: R-12 (owner ratification 2026-11-24: DanceFlow Studio/Custom policy; implementation verified only when the release candidate passes review and testing)
OD-01 (PR 832): never described as a governing-body rule
